title: Wire snapshot: public JSON of accepted and recommended References, projection task and CLI
description:
Phase 1 of the `wire` epic (working identifier, see the epic). Ships the public data files the Reference grids render from. On its own it is visible as `https://anth.us/_data/wire/references.json` once run on Anth.us.

## Goal
A projection task `wire-snapshot` reads the site's References and writes `_data/wire/references.json` with allowlisted public fields only, under the projection lease, reconcile-safe, re-rendering the pages that read it. A CLI command runs the same code locally or against a bucket.

## Files to create

- `src/papyrus_content/wire/export.py`: `collect_references(client, corpus_id, settings) -> list[dict]`, `public_reference(row, decision, preview, section_labels, settings) -> dict`, `public_key(lineage_id) -> str` (`hashlib.sha256(lineage_id.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]`), `accept_probability(decision)` (port of `lib/reference-feed-ranking.ts` `acceptProbability`: 0.5 undecided, 0.6 unrecorded confidence, label vs `positiveLabel ?? - `src/papyrus_content/wire/task.py`: `run_wire_snapshot(context, client, settings) -> dict` = `with context.leased(): write file if changed; report = project_listings(context); optional purge if settings.freshness.purge`. Report `{written, unchanged, references, pagesRewritten, purged}`.

## Files to change
- `src/papyrus_content/projection/plugins.py`: add `WIRE_DATA_DIRECTORY = "_data/wire"` to `PLUGIN_RUNTIME_DIRECTORIES` so reconcile never treats the files as orphans.
- `src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/config.py`: add `wire` to `STANDARD_KEYS`; parse into `WireSettings` (`standard.wire`, None when absent).
- `src/papyrus_content/graphql_authoring.py`: register in `INDEX_DEFINITIONS` nothing new for References (`referencesByCurationStatusKey`, `referencesByFeedStateAndPrediction`, `semanticRelationsBySubjectState`, `referenceAttachmentsByReferenceLineageAndSortKey` exist); add `MESSAGE_FIELDS` `editedAt`, `deletedAt`, `deletedBySub` (needed by the threads task; harmless now).
- `amplify/functions/content-actions/handler.py` `run_projection_task`: new branch `task == "wire-snapshot"` calling `run_wire_snapshot(projection_context(client), client, settings)`; settings come from the site's `projection.json` through the projector (`context.projector.standard.wire`).
- `src/papyrus_content/cli.py` (or wherever `knowledge snapshot` is registered): `papyrus wire snapshot [--site KEY | --site-bucket B] [--out DIR] [--dry-run]`. Mutation commands write by default; `--dry-run` prints the report and the file size only.
- `docs/wire.md` (new, short: data files, fields, task, CLI). Full docs are the docs task.

## Data access
- Accepted: `client.list_by_index("referencesByCurationStatusKey", f"{corpus_id}#accepted")`, keep `versionState == "current"` (as `auto_accept.current_references`).
- Pending: `client.list_by_index("referencesByFeedStateAndPrediction", f"{corpus_id}#unrated")`, keep `predictedAcceptProbability >= recommendedThreshold` after computing the live probability (below).
- Live decision per lineage: `client.list_by_index("semanticRelationsBySubjectState", f"reference#{lineageId}#current")`, filter `predicate == "relevance_decision_is"`; reuse `ideas/digest.py` `relations_of` / `relevance_of` if importable without side effects, else copy the two functions into `export.py`.
- Preview: `client.list_reference_attachments_by_lineage(lineageId)`, `role == "preview"`: `sourceUri` -> `image`, `metadata.description` -> `summary`.
- Section labels: `NewsroomSection` records (`list_records("NewsroomSection")`) mapped id -> label.
- No new GSI is needed for References.

## Public record shape (one entry)
```json
{"key": "3f9a1c0b7d2e", "status": "accepted", "title": "...", "url": "https://...", "host": "example.org", "sourceDate": "2026-10-30", "acceptedAt": "2026-10-31T09:12:00.000Z", "arrivedAt": "2026-10-30T22:01:00.000Z", "section": "Articles", "confidence": 0.93, "actor": "editor", "image": "https://...", "summary": "..."}
```
`status` is `accepted` or `recommended`. A field absent from `wire.references.fields` is not written (`key`, `status`, `url`, `title`, `arrivedAt` are always written). Never write: `curationStatusUpdatedBy`, `curationStatusReason`, `curationDelegation`, `versionCreatedBy`, `discoveryDetails`, `discoveryRule`, `lineageId`, `id`, `corpusId`, `authors` (until open question 4 is decided).

## Gherkin scenarios (features_backend/wire-snapshot.feature)
- "A site without a wire setting writes no wire files and the projector ignores the task"
- "Accepted current References are exported newest-accepted first with only allowlisted fields"
- "Pending References at or above the recommended threshold are exported as recommended; rejected, archived and superseded ones never are"
- "The live Cyclotron decision sets confidence the way the newsroom console computes it"
- "A preview attachment supplies image and summary; a Reference without one has neither field"
- "The public files hold no email, person id, Cognito sub or UUID" (use `procedures/newsroom/tests/reader_privacy.py` `identity_leaks` with an empty allowlist)
- "An unchanged snapshot is not rewritten and no page is re-rendered"
- "A changed snapshot rewrites only the pages that read it" (needs a page with a `references` include from the include task; write the step now, mark the scenario @wip until that task lands, or land both in one PR)
- "Reconcile leaves _data/wire files alone"
- "The snapshot honours urls.basePath"
- "papyrus wire snapshot --dry-run writes nothing and prints the report"

## Acceptance checks
- `behave features_backend/wire-snapshot.feature` green; unit tests green; `ruff`/`mypy` as the repo's CI runs them.
- Manual: `AWS_PROFILE=papyrus-production papyrus wire snapshot --site anth-us --dry-run` prints counts (read-only). A real run on Anth.us is part of the Anth.us task, after Ryan's go.

## Dependencies
None. Blocks: references include, freshness, threads.
